expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.U===400 && S.P===200 && S.l===150 && Math.abs(S.Ph-1.5)<1e-9 ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===3 && R[0].min==='20' && R[0].max==='400' && R[0].step==='10' && R[1].min==='50' && R[1].max==='500' && R[1].step==='50' && R[2].min==='10' && R[2].max==='300' && R[2].step==='10' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: three sliders: U 20–400 kV by 10, P 50–500 MW by 50, l 10–300 km by 10

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words
